d: A figure of athletic, muscular build is fully encased in a high-tech, charcoal-black tactical suit with silver-grey ribbed undersuit accents. The head is covered by a sleek, black aerodynamic helmet featuring a glowing crimson circular digital display with the number 9 in the center, concealing the face and any hair. The ensemble includes heavy armored plating on the shoulders and legs, a white power pack with a thin antenna on the back, and a large, black futuristic rifle with glowing red accents held in silver-armored hands.
